ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, num_of_reviews DESC
LIMIT 15;

       COUNT(i.inspection_id) as inspection_count,
       MAX(i.inspection_date) as last_inspection_date,
       AVG(i.inspection_score) as avg_inspection_score
FROM establishments e
LEFT JOIN establishment_keys ek ON LOWER(ek.name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(SPLIT_PART(e.name, ' ', 1)) || '%' 
  AND LOWER(ek.address) LIKE '%' || LOWER(SPLIT_PART(e.address, ',', 1)) || '%'
LEFT JOIN inspections i ON i.slchd_establishment_key = COALESCE(e.slchd_establishment_key, ek.slchd_establishment_key)
WHERE e.name IN ('King Buffet', 'Red Lotus Bistro', "Charlie Chow's Dragon Grill", 'Sozo Kitchen', 'Mi La-Cai Noodle House', "P.F. Chang's")
GROUP BY e.name, e.address, e.gmap_id, e.slchd_establishment_key, ek.slchd_establishment_key;

ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, num_of_reviews DESC;
